prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE landscape 1536x1024 PAINTED 2D CHARACTER ANIMATION DESIGN BOARD, based very faithfully on the attached character. The user strongly prefers this original chunky hand-painted cave explorer and rejects flat generic simplified characters. KEEP the original identity: huge round dusty blue-green cloth hood, warm cream oval face with small black eyes and eyebrows, playful small angular smile, ochre shoulder yoke and chest, thick dark brown work mittens and boots, squat capable silhouette, confident rough black ink edges and broad mottled gouache brush patches. KEEP the charm and hand-painted material quality. Do NOT convert to flat vector art or glossy 3D. Adapt CONSTRUCTION for a 2D Spine cutout workflow: modestly lengthen upper/lower limbs about 15 percent relative to original to allow bends, clearly separate elbow and knee silhouettes, one simple dark belt with one buckle instead of many belt pouches, a single small flat rear canvas pouch wholly behind torso, ochre shoulder cap cleanly overlapping the upper arm, long glove cuffs hiding wrist seams, boot cuffs hiding ankle seams. Head and face remain almost rigid shapes in animation. Avoid deep cast shadows painted from one moving limb onto another; keep painted broad texture inside individual pieces. This is a concept board, not an actual exported rig.
Layout: warm light parchment background with restrained texture. Heading 'DARK NIGHTS' and subtitle 'PAINTED 2D / SPINE STUDY'. LEFT 45%: one large complete character in a fixed right-facing side-three-quarter SETUP pose, chest only slightly visible, both boots facing right, near arm angled forward/down enough to separate wrist from waist, far arm distinguishable behind torso, legs slightly separated, every hand and foot visible. Label 'SIDE SETUP'. CENTER 22%: a clean visual exploded study of ONLY the NEAR ARM from the very same character: ochre shoulder cap, blue-green upper sleeve with a rounded complete hidden shoulder end, blue-green forearm with rounded complete hidden elbow end, dark mitten with cuff. Four painted cutout-like pieces separated vertically with ample gaps. Small dashed guide line connects their intended joint centers, use tiny simple circular pivot marks only in this arm study. Label 'OVERLAP STUDY'. Do not make this a mechanical prosthetic. RIGHT 33%: three smaller full-body drawings stacked vertically, each same fixed camera angle and character design as large setup. Top relaxed standing pose 'IDLE'; middle readable walking stride with opposed arms 'WALK'; bottom a bent-knee anticipatory mining pose with BOTH mitten hands correctly gripping a single wooden-handled plain iron pickaxe raised forward above shoulder 'MINE'. Keep pickaxe clear of the hood, two arms only, coherent anatomy. No motion blur or action swishes. All poses look like the same painted 2D cutout character with constant costume and head shape, no view rotation or perspective change. These are discrete pose sketches, not a claim of actual animation. Keep generous margins and do not crop any character or tool. Consistent large color blocks and strong silhouette, little tiny surface noise, retain the original warm craft quality. No cave panel, no scenery, no UI, no extra people, no technical paragraphs, no 3D render.
